visual_logic.surface_detail: Sleek, 'Oceanic Blue' skin with 'Silver-Grey' countershading on the belly, completely smooth like a dolphin's skin, running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. Hero focus remains on the four paddle-like flippers and the downward-curved tail vertebrae supporting the fluke, oriented parallel to the camera plane.

environment.water: Deep teal water with diffused sunlight rays, balanced to keep the lateral outline completely measurable.
environment.biota: The marine snow, school of 'Leptolepis' fish, and forest of kelp-like algae are shifted entirely into the distant background layers to preserve a sharp, unobstructed silhouette line.

pose: The fully marine metriorhynchid crocodyliform is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original dynamic high-speed mid-roll chase pose is unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its elongated snout, streamlined torso, differentiated paddle limbs, and hypocercal tail fluke end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
